description: This file defines the PrintNode class in Twig, representing a node that outputs an expression in a Twig template's abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: Twig\Node\PrintNode
classes.description: A node class responsible for outputting an expression during template compilation. It extends Node and implements NodeOutputInterface, handling the compilation of expression nodes into PHP code that outputs or yields values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PrintNode with a given expression and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, outputting either a 'yield' or 'yield from' statement based on whether the expression is a generator.
